assumptions.statement: The submitted SITE_BOUNDARY and three KEY_AREA polygons are repository-maintained provisional rough geometry.
assumptions.impact: Boundary-sensitive areas, ratios, drawings and spatial conclusions must be recalculated after official or cleared polygons are provided.

assumptions.statement: Official FAR, building height, building density, green-ratio, setback, skyline and other regulatory controls are not present in the cleared site package.
assumptions.impact: The proposal uses conceptual land-use, building and public-space roles and does not state statutory numerical controls.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, cross-sections, station integration drawings, bicycle parking inventory and activity-day traffic conditions are not present.
assumptions.impact: Road and rail content remains a conceptual slow-mobility and station-connection strategy, not an engineering alignment.

assumptions.statement: Parcel boundaries, ownership, existing leases and implementation responsibilities are not present.
assumptions.impact: Retain, renovate, demolish and new-build labels are conceptual update categories and cannot be treated as parcel decisions.

assumptions.statement: Existing building footprints, heights, uses, ages and structural conditions are not available.
assumptions.impact: The building layer expresses proposed spatial roles only; building footprint area is not existing floor area or approved development scale.

assumptions.statement: Heritage protection boundaries and construction-control zones for the Jing-Zhang railway heritage resources are not included.
assumptions.impact: Cultural nodes, signage and public-space components must be reviewed by heritage professionals before any physical implementation.

assumptions.statement: Municipal utilities, drainage, flood control, fire access, energy and end-side computing conditions are not available.
assumptions.impact: Low-carbon, edge-computing and public-service scenarios are bounded prototypes for professional deepening, not capacity or feasibility conclusions.

assumptions.statement: All AI scenario cards are conceptual suggestions and require public explanation, data minimization, human review, exit conditions and accountable operators.
assumptions.impact: No scenario is described as approved, fully deployed, or dependent on a named vendor or private dataset.

assumptions.statement: The package uses original generated text, diagrams and offline HTML plus public or cleared repository sources; no external visual asset is required.
assumptions.impact: Any future replacement asset must be checked for license, attribution and authorization before inclusion.
